# Predictive Maintenance Review

**Site AUS-1 (fictional), Hall A.** Backtest over the condition history, Mar 2, 2026 to Aug 30, 2026 (26 weeks), and the sample month as of Sep 27, 2026. Interactive version: [Predictive view of the Failure Pattern Review](https://jasonmossotti.github.io/dco-vendor-scorecard/patterns/#predict).

> A prediction is a forecast that proposes work. It is not a finding and changes no SLA result. The backtest runs the detectors over the history as if they had been running then; nobody acted on the warnings, so every failure in the records still happens.

## Backtest

| Detector | Warned in time | Share | Lead needed | Median lead | False alarms | Owner (Interface Agreement RACI) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Optics (DOM trend) | 69 of 108 module failures (the module's own DOM alarm) (4 more in the first 5 days of data, too early to judge) | 64% | 24 hours | 10.0 days | 0 | IT Partner (does the work), Customer (accountable) |
| GPU memory (corrected errors and remaps) | 36 of 68 uncorrectable memory XIDs | 53% | 24 hours | 4.6 days | 0 | IT Partner (does the work), Customer (accountable) |
| CDU filter (pressure drop to the change limit) | 1 of 1 times a filter reached its change limit | 100% | 7 days | 29.5 days | 0 | Landlord |
| CDU pumps (speed for the flow) | 1 of 2 pump failures (Redfish health Critical) | 50% | 7 days | 28.7 days | 0 | Landlord |

Failures the detectors did not warn of gave no sign in the readings they watch (a module that fails at once, a pump that stops without wearing first); nothing in the data could have predicted them. 16 GPU memory flags came after the XID they follow and are not counted as warnings.

## Method

- **Optics:** each module's daily worst-lane laser bias, transmit power, and receive power. A reading far from the module's own baseline, moving steadily toward its warning threshold over 5 days (a step or a one-day dip is not a trend), is projected with a Theil-Sen slope; a warning reached within 14 days raises a work request. A receive-power trend whose far end's transmit power is falling belongs to the far end's module.
- **GPU memory:** the GPU Health tab's early-warning rule (remapped rows or corrected errors rising), run once per episode.
- **CDU filter:** pressure drop corrected to design flow (it scales with flow squared), trended since the last change; a work request when it will reach 28 kPa (twice the clean pressure drop) before the next scheduled change (91 days) and within 30 days.
- **CDU pumps:** speed against flow, compared with the pump's own first days on duty (relearned when it is replaced); a CUSUM on the residual raises a watch, and 1% more speed than the flow needs raises a work request.
- **Fleet outlook:** a Weibull fit of module lifetimes with censoring and left truncation; a Poisson rate for GPU memory failures.
- Every threshold and its basis is in `config/predict.yaml`; each detector's inputs, limits, and blind spots are in `docs/predict/`.

*Synthetic data for a portfolio demonstration; all names and events are fictional.*
